# The critic's calibration set — the first FP/FN table

Plan item 12 (week 2): *the critic's calibration set, first members* — a fixed reference set of ~30 **real renders** with seeded defects, run through the scripted checks, publishing false-positive and false-negative rates **per defect class**.

Every verdict in this table wears **`verdict@scripted`** on its face, because no critic *model* has been chosen and measured yet (X R4: the critic is "the largest unchosen dependency in the whole stack"). This row is the **baseline** that the model choice (week 3 item 18) has to beat.

## The band

§1.9's band: **catch the seeded defects** (no false negatives) and **reject no more than one in 10 of the clean ones**.

**Out of band.** The scripted checks do not yet hold the band, and the verdicts stay `verdict@scripted` — the plan's M2 named risk, as a measurement rather than a worry.

- `clipped_geometry` (check `edge_cut`): 1 missed.

## The thresholds, and what they were measured on

Every threshold is set on a **measurement of the clean controls**, not a guess. The scripts that produce those numbers are `core/critic/measure_image.py` (the image checks) and `core/critic/measure_mesh.py` (the mesh checks), so the numbers can be re-derived from the same sweep.

| threshold | value | what it was set against |
|---|---|---|
| `black_mean_luma` | `0.02` | the darkest clean frame's mean luminance was 0.103 (river-s5) |
| `firefly_count` | `250` | the worst clean frame measured 154 isolated outliers (sun glitter on water, not a defect); the planted defects measure 307–472 |
| `flat_region_frac` | `0.01` | the largest exact-colour region in a clean frame was 30 px (0.006 % of the frame); the planted ones are 2.8 %–6.5 % |
| `hole_min_contrast` | `0.12` | the clean frames measured no uniform dark blob at all, so the threshold is the plant's own visibility margin |
| `seam_min_strength` | `0.33` | the strongest four-sided rectangle in a clean frame steps by 0.286; the planted swaps step by 0.46 at their median |
| `float_min_gap` | `0.1` | the clean frames' candidate blobs reach 0.104 frame heights of open space under them at the ninth percentile |
| `scale_max` | `6.0` | the clean scenes' own prop families vary by up to 5.48× their family's median (a family of chopped trees holds stumps and whole trees), so the threshold sits above that natural spread |
| `hollow_inward` | `0.7` | the clean props' worst inward-facing fraction was 0.593 — vegetation is full of inward faces |
| `edge_cut_margin` | `0.01` | the closest a clean prop's middle comes to the picture's edge is 0.0105 of its own half-width, and no clean scene has a prop that close |

## Reproducing this

```bash
# re-harvest the sweep, grow the set, re-score and publish
.venv/bin/python -m core.critic --grow --publish

# the clean frames' measurements (the thresholds' basis)
.venv/bin/python core/critic/measure_image.py

# the mesh half's measurements
.venv/bin/python core/critic/measure_mesh.py <scene.blend>
```

The set is a **recipe**, not a pile of pictures: every member records the base render's sha256 and the recipe of its seeded defect, so a member can be re-derived from the base render alone, and the table rebuilds from the members without the original images.
